description: Return nearby objects and nearby Sims within a radius — the same slice the perception stream emits on its nearby_objects + nearby_sims fields, on demand. Prerequisite: you are joined to a lot and the local VM has caught up. Effect: none — local-VM read, no outbound PDU. Results include everything within radius_tiles of your current tile; objects multi-tile-grouped are de-duplicated to the base tile so a bed counts once, not four times. Out-of-world entities are filtered. Cost: O(entities in lot) scan under the VM tick lock; for a fully populated TSO lot this is still microseconds. Use when you need a fresh nearby scan mid-turn (e.g., after moving) without waiting for the next perception tick. Default radius 20 tiles matches the perception stream's default; tighter radii surface fewer candidates for focused decisions.

args.name: radius_tiles
args.description: Search radius in tiles (must be positive). Converted to engine-native 1/16-tile units internally. 20 tiles = a room plus adjacent rooms; matches what the perception stream uses.

call_signatures: cf $CF query-nearby                                                                  # default radius 20 tiles (matches perception)
cf $CF query-nearby --radius_tiles 5                                                 # narrow radius to near-immediate neighbourhood
common_mistakes: These are LOCAL VM reads — they reflect whatever your client-side replica VM shows, which may lag the authoritative state by 1-2 ticks.
Do not rely on query-inventory until freesoexperiment-1a9 closes — it returns deferred:true with items=[].
perception_hints: These ops return the same shape as the corresponding perception slice; use for fresh mid-turn snapshots
Perception already pushes this data at FSO_PERCEPTION_HZ — only call when you need data newer than the last tick
